From 840ece19e9f246a1b15308ae76b68aaf7a3a9433 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Colin Foster <colin.foster@in-advantage.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2021 23:40:10 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] net: ocelot: fix missed include in the vsc7514_regs.h file

commit 32ecd22ba60b ("net: mscc: ocelot: split register definitions to a
separate file") left out an include for <soc/mscc/ocelot_vcap.h>. It was
missed because the only consumer was ocelot_vsc7514.h, which already
included ocelot_vcap.

Fixes: 32ecd22ba60b ("net: mscc: ocelot: split register definitions to a separate file")
Signed-off-by: Colin Foster <colin.foster@in-advantage.com>
Reviewed-by: Florian Fainelli <f.fainelli@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20211209074010.1813010-1-colin.foster@in-advantage.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/include/soc/mscc/vsc7514_regs.h b/include/soc/mscc/vsc7514_regs.h
index 98743e252012..ceee26c96959 100644
--- a/include/soc/mscc/vsc7514_regs.h
+++ b/include/soc/mscc/vsc7514_regs.h
@@ -8,6 +8,8 @@
 #ifndef VSC7514_REGS_H
 #define VSC7514_REGS_H
 
+#include <soc/mscc/ocelot_vcap.h>
+
 extern const u32 vsc7514_ana_regmap[];
 extern const u32 vsc7514_qs_regmap[];
 extern const u32 vsc7514_qsys_regmap[];
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `include/soc/mscc/vsc7514_regs.h`**
   - An include directive for `<soc/mscc/ocelot_vcap.h>` was added. This inclusion ensures that the definitions and declarations from the `ocelot_vcap.h` file are available in the `vsc7514_regs.h` file.

### Relationships

- The modification in `vsc7514_regs.h` addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (32ecd22ba60b) that split register definitions into a separate file but omitted the necessary include for `ocelot_vcap.h`. The addition of the include statement in the current patch restores the required dependency, ensuring that the functionality relying on `ocelot_vcap.h` works correctly within the context of `vsc7514_regs.h`.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the omission of the include directive for `<soc/mscc/ocelot_vcap.h>` in the `vsc7514_regs.h` file after the register definitions were split into a separate file. This omission meant that any references to types or functions defined in `ocelot_vcap.h` would not be recognized, leading to potential compilation errors or undefined behavior when the `vsc7514_regs.h` file was used.

```c
#include <soc/mscc/ocelot_vcap.h>
```
Reason:
Adding the include directive for `<soc/mscc/ocelot_vcap.h>` ensures that all necessary types and functions defined in that header file are recognized in `vsc7514_regs.h`, thus preventing compilation errors and ensuring correct behavior when the file is used.
